title: Twitch Chat
description: A mod for Minecraft that brings Twitch chat directly to your game.
body: # 🟣 Twitch Chat in Minecraft A Minecraft mod that displays your Twitch chat directly in the game. Only **you** see the messages — other players on the server see nothing. *** ## ✅ What is this for? If you're streaming Minecraft and want to read Twitch chat without alt-tabbing, this mod shows messages directly in the in-game chat in real time. Example: ``` [mod] viewer123: hello streamer! [vip] coolguy: gg wp [Owner] finboy99: when is the next stream? ``` *** ## 📦 Supported Versions | Minecraft Version |Loader |Java | | ----------------- |-------------------- |------- | | 1.26.1 |Fabric Loader 0.18.5 |Java 25 | | 1.21.1 |NeoForge 21.1.172 |Java 21 | *** ## 🔧 Installation 1. Install **Fabric** or **NeoForge** for your Minecraft version 2. Download **Fabric API** (for Fabric) 3. Place all `.jar` files into your `mods/` folder 4. Launch Minecraft *** ## 🎮 Commands | Command |Description | | ------------------------ |-------------------------------------------- | | /twitch channel <name> |Set and save the Twitch channel | | /twitch start |Start receiving chat | | /twitch stop |Stop receiving chat | | /twitch reload |Reconnect to the channel | | /twitch autostart on/off |Auto-connect when joining a world | | /twitch sound <nick> |Play a sound when your nickname is mentioned | | /twitch language ru/en |Change interface language | | /twitch status |Show current connection status | | /twitch help |Show all commands | > `/twich` also works — typo protection included. *** ## 🚀 Quick Start ``` /twitch channel yourchannel /twitch start ``` *** ## 🏷️ Chat Badges The mod automatically displays Twitch user roles: | Badge |Role | | ---------- |------------------- | | [streamer] |Channel broadcaster | | [mod] |Moderator | | [vip] |VIP | | [sub] |Subscriber | | [✓] |Twitch Partner | | [prime] |Prime subscriber | | [founder] |Channel founder | | [bits] |Bits cheerer | | (none) |Regular viewer | *** ## 🔔 Mention Notifications Set your nickname: ``` /twitch sound yournick ``` When someone mentions your nickname in Twitch chat: * A sound notification plays * The message is highlighted in-game *** ## 💾 Configuration All settings are stored in: ``` config/twitchchat.json ``` Saved settings include: * Selected channel * Auto-start preference * Interface language * Mention nickname *** ## ❓ How It Works The mod connects to **Twitch IRC anonymously**. That means: ✅ No login required ✅ No OAuth token required ✅ Read-only access The mod can: * Read public chat messages * Display them locally in Minecraft The mod cannot: * Send messages * Moderate chat * Access private channels *** ## ⚠️ Requirements * **Client-side only** (do not install on a server) * Internet connection required * Twitch channel must be **public** *** ## 📄 License MIT License Do whatever you want. *** ## 👤 Author [@boing\_lover](https://tg.me/boing_lover)
